name: board_frame_v3
prompt: A sleek, elegant WIDE slot-machine board frame seen straight on, for a premium cartoon slot game set at a night-time American gas station, matching a 7-column by 5-row board. A SLIM polished chrome bezel (thin, refined, not chunky) with softly rounded corners, a crisp hot-red neon tube running just inside it with a soft red glow spilling inward, tiny chrome rivets only at the corners. Centred on the top edge, overlapping it, a compact vintage roadside sign topper: a small cream-and-red enamel sign with the word "FALCOS" (spelled exactly F-A-L-C-O-S) in glowing red neon script and a little neon star. No plaque on the bottom edge. The whole inside of the frame is EMPTY and fully transparent - a big wide window taking about 94% of the width and 86% of the height. Polished high-end cartoon illustration, clean ink outlines, cel shading, glossy highlights. Fully transparent background outside the frame. No other text.
